About.title: About
About.lede: Full-Stack engineer in Bishkek. Writing code since 2022, commercially since 2024.
story: I come from Baul, a village in Leylek District of Batken Region, the far south of Kyrgyzstan. In 9th grade my brother Daniyar introduced me to ManchoDevs: I came to their office in Bishkek, saw the team at work and knew what I wanted to do.

Back home I started teaching myself: Udemy, YouTube, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. I built small projects and solved LeetCode problems, often in breaks between herding cattle. An unusual path, but it led where it had to.
Now I build web apps and admin panels for five Mancho Devs products and teach frontend at Mancho School, the same school where I studied Software Engineering.

About.profile: Full Stack developer with 2+ years of commercial experience in fintech and logistics. Stack: React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Node.js, AWS serverless. I mentor frontend students at Mancho School.

items.label: Full-stack development
items.text: I build web apps and admin panels for 5 company products: frontend with React and Gatsby, backend with Node.js, GraphQL and AWS. I design APIs and data models.

items.label: Tests and releases
items.text: I write unit, component and E2E tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress), maintain CI/CD in GitHub Actions and investigate production incidents using AWS CloudWatch logs.

items.label: Onboarding
items.text: Onboarded a new frontend developer to the umrahhajj project and reviewed their pull requests.

items.label: Mentoring
items.text: Taught frontend development to 20+ students: lectures, workshops, code review, help with projects.

items.label: Frontend

items.label: Volunteering
items.text: Taught HTML, CSS and JavaScript to young people from villages who needed support.
